tools.name: proto_batch_export
tools.description: Batch Export: Export currently-selected Export Items. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_quick_export_mesh
tools.description:
Quick Export Mesh: Export selected meshes (and up to 1 Armature) as an FBX mesh.

Must include an Armature in order for this mesh to be animated. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_quick_export_mesh_and_animations
tools.description:
Quick Export Mesh and Animations: Export selected meshes (and up to 1 Armature) as an FBX mesh, with all of its animations (if any)

Must include an Armature in order for this mesh to be animated. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_quick_export_allactions
tools.description:
Quick Export All Actions: Export all Actions on selected Armature as FBX animations.
Do not select the bound Mesh, unless the Mesh has Shape Key animation. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_quick_export_curaction
tools.description:
Quick Export Current Action: Export current Action on selected Armature as an FBX animation.
Do not select the bound Mesh, unless the Mesh has Shape Key animation
NOTE: will export the Action's frame range, not the current Timeline. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_apply_all_modifiers_keep_shape_keys
tools.description:
Apply All Modifiers: Apply all Modifiers on the active Mesh, while preserving Shape Keys
* By default, Armature Modifiers will be skipped

EXPERIMENTAL: this is complicated and may have cases that do not work. Please report bugs with this option if you experience them. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_apply_active_modifier_keep_shape_keys
tools.description:
Apply Active Modifier: Apply the active Modifier on the active Mesh, while preserving Shape Keys
* Use the object's Modifiers panel to select the active Modifier

EXPERIMENTAL: this is complicated and may have cases that do not work. Please report bugs with this option if you experience them. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: proto_vertex_group_to_vertex_color
tools.description: Vertex Group To Vertex Color): Copy the weight of the current Vertex Group into the given channel of the current Vertex Color Attribute. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

channel.description: Which color channel to fill (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha)

invert.description: Invert the Vertex Group values before copying to Vertex Colors

skip_mask.description:
Skip the active Paint Mask.

NOTE: Paint Mask is only visible in Vertex Paint mode, but can still be applied in all modes

tools.name: proto_fill_vertex_color
tools.description: Fill Vertex Color: Set the given channel of the current Vertex Color Attribute to the given weight. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

channel.description: Which color channel to fill (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha)

skip_mask.description:
If True, skip the active Paint Mask.

NOTE: Paint Mask is only visible in Vertex Paint mode, but can still be applied in all modes

tools.name: proto_timelinetoaction
tools.description: Set Timeline: Set the Scene Timeline to match the start and end of the current Action. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
